notes: Read the full 94-line source with numbered lines before editing.
L1-7 doc comment (operator-task row, severity drives colour, optional CTA): preserved/expanded in the native file header.
L9 `import { type ReactNode }`: preserved as `import {type ReactNode} from 'react'` for the description prop.
L10 `import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'`: replaced — no in-app router on native; route navigation goes through `useNativeHrefNavigation` -> `Linking.openURL` (best-effort, errors swallowed).

L11 lucide-react Info/AlertTriangle/AlertCircle/ChevronRight: replaced with severity-tinted inline AppText glyphs (info 'ℹ', warn '⚠', error '⛔', chevron '›') matching the established SeverityBadge port.
L12 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'`: dropped — native uses StyleSheet + style arrays instead of className merging.
L14 `export type ActionSeverity = 'info' | 'warn' | 'error'`: preserved verbatim.

L16-20 SEVERITY_CFG (icon/text/bg/ring per severity): ported to a token-driven SeverityVisual map — text-blue-400/amber-400/red-400 -> colors.accent/warning/danger (fg); bg-*-500/10 -> surfaceSelected/warningSurface/dangerSurface; ring-*-400/20 -> borderAccent/warningBorder/dangerBorder; lucide icon -> glyph.
L22-29 ActionItemProps (severity, title, description?: ReactNode, cta {label,to?,external?,onClick?}): preserved verbatim; added optional `testID` for native test targeting; doc comments retained.
L31-33 ActionItem signature + cfg/Icon lookup: preserved (cfg lookup kept; Icon constant folded into the cfg.glyph render).

L36-42 outer div `flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg p-3 ring-1` + bg/ring: -> View styles.row (flexDirection row, alignItems flex-start, gap spacing.md, borderRadius 8, padding spacing.md, borderWidth 1) with per-severity bg/border.

L43 `<Icon className='h-5 w-5 shrink-0 mt-0.5' aria-hidden />`: -> severity-tinted AppText glyph (fontSize 16, marginTop 2) with accessibilityElementsHidden/importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' for aria-hidden parity.

L45-50 body `flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-0.5` + title `text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]` + description `text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]`: -> View styles.body (flex 1, gap 2); title AppText (fontSize 14, fontWeight 500, textPrimary); description rendered via string/number -> AppText (fontSize 12, textSecondary) else ReactNode -> View wrapper.
L47-49 `{description && (...)}`: reproduced as an explicit truthiness guard so a falsy node never renders a bare value outside a Text node on native.
L52-54 `{cta && <ActionCTA cta=... severityText=cfg.text />}`: preserved — renders ActionCTA with severityColor=cfg.fg when cta present.

L59-65 ActionCTA + baseClasses (inline-flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium min-h-[36px] hover/focus + severityText): -> Pressable styles.cta (row, alignItems center, gap spacing.xs, borderRadius 6, paddingH spacing.md, paddingV 6, minHeight 36, flexShrink 0, alignSelf flex-start) + pressed-surface state; label AppText fontSize 12/fontWeight 500 tinted by severityColor.

L67-75 `cta.to && cta.external` -> `label + ChevronRight`: -> Pressable accessibilityRole='link' onPress navigate(cta.to); external carries no separate native transport (documented) and is preserved on the prop type.
L76-81 `cta.to` -> `<Link to>label + ChevronRight</Link>`: -> same Pressable navigate(cta.to) path (role='link').
L84-91 `cta.onClick` -> `<button type=button onClick>label + ChevronRight</button>`: -> Pressable accessibilityRole='button' onPress cta.onClick().
L72/L79/L88 ChevronRight `h-3.5 w-3.5`: -> inline '›' AppText glyph tinted by severityColor, aria-hidden.
L93 `return null` (no to + no onClick): preserved as early `if (!cta.to && !cta.onClick) return null`.
L94 end of file / `export function ActionItem`: named export preserved; a convenience default export added per native-parity repo convention.
